fields.label: Deletion Policy
fields.help: Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance.

fields.label: Description
fields.help: An optional description of this resource.

fields.label: Name
fields.help: Name of the resource.

fields.label: Target
fields.help: URL of the managed instance group that this autoscaler will scale.

fields.label: Zone
fields.help: URL of the zone where the instance group resides.

fields.label: Autoscaling Policy
Cooldown Period
fields.help: The number of seconds that the autoscaler should wait before it starts collecting information from a new instance.

fields.label: Max Replicas
fields.help: The maximum number of instances that the autoscaler can scale up to.

fields.label: Min Replicas
fields.help: The minimum number of replicas that the autoscaler can scale down to.

fields.label: Mode
fields.help: Defines operating mode for this policy.

fields.label: Stabilization Period
fields.help: The number of seconds that the autoscaler waits for load stabilization before making scale-in decisions.

fields.label: Cpu Utilization
Predictive Method
fields.help: Indicates whether predictive autoscaling based on CPU metric is enabled.

fields.label: Target
fields.help: The target CPU utilization that the autoscaler should maintain.
Defines the CPU utilization policy that allows the autoscaler to scale based on the average CPU utilization of a managed instance group.

fields.label: Load Balancing Utilization
Target
fields.help: Fraction of backend capacity utilization (set in HTTP(s) load balancing configuration) that autoscaler should maintain.
Configuration parameters of autoscaling based on a load balancer.

fields.label: Metric
Filter
fields.help: A filter string to be used as the filter string for a Stackdriver Monitoring TimeSeries.list API call.

fields.label: Name
fields.help: The identifier (type) of the Stackdriver Monitoring metric.

fields.label: Single Instance Assignment
fields.help: If scaling is based on a per-group metric value that represents the total amount of work to be done or resource usage, set this value to an amount assigned for a single instance of the scaled group.

fields.label: Target
fields.help: The target value of the metric that autoscaler should maintain.

fields.label: Type
fields.help: Defines how target utilization value is expressed for a Stackdriver Monitoring metric.
Configuration parameters of autoscaling based on a custom metric.

fields.label: Scale In Control
Time Window Sec
fields.help: How long back autoscaling should look when computing recommendations to include directives regarding slower scale down, as described above.

fields.label: Max Scaled In Replicas
Fixed
fields.help: Specifies a fixed number of VM instances.

fields.label: Percent
fields.help: Specifies a percentage of instances between 0 to 100%, inclusive.
A nested object resource.
Defines scale in controls to reduce the risk of response latency and outages due to abrupt scale-in events

fields.label: Scaling Schedules
Description
fields.help: A description of a scaling schedule.

fields.label: Disabled
fields.help: A boolean value that specifies if a scaling schedule can influence autoscaler recommendations.

fields.label: Duration Sec
fields.help: The duration of time intervals (in seconds) for which this scaling schedule will be running.

fields.label: Min Required Replicas
fields.help: Minimum number of VM instances that autoscaler will recommend in time intervals starting according to schedule.

fields.label: Schedule
fields.help: The start timestamps of time intervals when this scaling schedule should provide a scaling signal.

fields.label: Time Zone
fields.help: The time zone to be used when interpreting the schedule.
Scaling schedules defined for an autoscaler.
The configuration parameters for the autoscaling algorithm.
